protocol.role: KnownDEV exploratory finite candidate comparison; protocol written after predictor error review, not independentTEST or preregistration
protocol.task: Same map and initial root, choose from9 geometric routes and2 speed requests, stage-constant alpha0/.5/1
protocol.fixed_alpha: Each diagonal alpha pair fixed; evaluate all9routes x2speeds =18 queries. Speed-only is exactly fixed alpha0 under this definition, report alias rather than invent a distinct method.
protocol.joint_budget18: Nine deterministic offsets0..8; for each route0..8 and speed_index0..1 choose stage-alpha pair index(route+3*speed_index+offset)%9 in lexicographic pair ordering. Each offset has18 queries; report all offsets, no best-offset selection.
protocol.selection: Among raw admitted candidates minimize predicted goal_time_s; deterministic tie alpha_pair,route,speed. No actual success or trajectory used for selection.
protocol.oracle: Existence of actual successful candidate in same queried set; no fabricated optimal time
protocol.comparison: Report selected actual task outcome, no-plan, feasible-but-rejected, query count, all per-root choices; raw model gates not certified/calibrated; both before/after exposure predictors
protocol.identity: Before comparing confirm candidate initial physical states agree and map grouping from source manifest, not filename guesses
protocol.initialization_amendment: Inspection found deterministic task-start reset differences in last history frame, nominal/rates and path follower/projection fields. Verify physical/RB and remaining controller carry exactly; record differing fields. This is task-start plan selection with candidate-conditioned reset, NOT online same-full-snapshot counterfactual.

scope: KnownDEV four map/root tasks; nine budget offsets reuse these same tasks, not independent seeds. Speed-only is fixed_alpha0, not an additional distinct algorithm. Raw uncalibrated gates. Task-start selection: candidate-dependent deterministic controller reset fields differ; not common-full-history online replanning.
actual_label_access: Only after selection, for outcome scoring and Oracle feasibility
